name: room
text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text: Add InstantX-ComfyUI’s depth-aware upscaler to EXCAVA’s pipeline first. It preserves fine details in complex scenes better than standard upscalers, which directly boosts output quality without extra compute. The trade-off is a slight slowdown—depth-aware upscaling adds 10-15% runtime—but the 0.5%+ quality gain justifies it. Faces are still the bottleneck; lock RealVisXL 5.0’s face lock next.

name: Torque
text: Depth-aware upscalers won’t fix EXCAVA’s face fidelity drop because the core problem is motion artifacts, not resolution loss—adding detail to blurry frames won’t restore lost facial structure. Instead, test RealVisXL 5.0’s face lock first; if it cuts motion blur by 15%+ without new compute, that’s the 0.5% gain we need. Settle it with a blind A/B test: run 50 samples through both pipelines and measure face fidelity scores.
